source: U.S. Department of Defense, Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC), Military and Civilian Personnel by Service/Agency by State/Country (Updated Quarterly): location report, active-duty columns only

break.before: Sep 2008–Sep 2017: counts include personnel deployed in support of contingency operations (the source lists the CTS Deployment File).
break.after: Dec 2017 onward: permanently assigned personnel only; temporary duty and contingency deployments are not included. Overseas active duty fell 215,249 → 161,927 between Sep and Dec 2017 while the U.S. total rose, a reallocation, not a withdrawal. Series are not like-for-like across this break.
break.evidence: Dec 2017 table footnote: does not include personnel on temporary duty; Sep 2017 sources list the CTS Deployment File and Dec 2017 does not.

removal.note: Afghanistan has no row from Sep 2023; Iraq and Syria print 0 in Sep 2023 and have no row from Dec 2023. An absent row is not a zero.

space_force.note: Space Force is folded into the Air Force column (header AIR FORCE/SPACE FORCE) Dec 2021–Jun 2023 and has its own column from Sep 2023. Not split; air_force is not comparable across Sep 2023 and space_force is null before it.

derived.abroad_definition: abroad_total = printed OVERSEAS TOTAL − Σ territory rows (American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands). Includes afloat_unassigned rows.
